poses.label: Top
poses.description: Lie on a flat bench with feet planted and both dumbbells above your chest.

poses.label: Lower
poses.description: Bend both elbows to lower the dumbbells evenly toward the sides of your chest.

poses.label: Bottom
poses.description: Pause beside your chest with your wrists above your elbows and your upper arms angled away from your ribs.

poses.label: Press
poses.description: Press both dumbbells back up under control.

checks: Compared the flat bench setup, foot support, paired loads and controlled descent and press against ACE and the built-in cue.
Validated joint ranges, equipment anchors, contact and framing through the complete loop.
limitations: The three-quarter projection foreshortens the far arm. The lower position illustrates a controlled range.
Fit-test playback and screen-size review are pending integration.

source.artwork: Original. Drawn in code from the shared rig in web/js/guides.js.
